metadata.case_name: WONG PING SHING v. NGAI YUK KEUNG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Owned and operated a fruit stall business with his wife.
plaintiff.occupation_after: Business closed down about one year after the accident.

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to his left chest
source: P suffered from soft tissue inflammation to his left chest which caused him persistent pain
I find that P did not suffer from any crack or fracture of rib, but did suffer from soft tissue injury to his left chest, which may cause him long term on and off pain.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of muscle, fascia or tendon at thorax level

manifestations.description: mild tenderness at the left 6th to 8th ribs
gave up all sports after the accident
may have difficulty in lifting and carrying heavy objects

treatments_received: Accident and Emergency Department of the Tuen Mun Hospital (attendance on 19 November 2004)
Pok Oi Hospital (attended on 19 occasions from 24 March 2005 till 15 November 2005)
treatments_future: P gave evidence that he would continue to visit Mr. Cheung in the future.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: P said he had to give up all sports after the accident.
